name: Leading Dot
tagline: An explainer video where one dot carries the whole film with no cuts: it becomes a screen, a chart, a ring, a button and your logo.
youSay: /leading-dot explain how Nimbus turns meetings into notes, paper theme, end on nimbus.app
whatYouGet: A 15–30 second explainer where one dot never stops: it drops in, bounces across the words, grows into a phone, splits into features, draws a chart, types a prompt, floods the frame and lands as the dot of your logo's i
Twelve moves your agent picks line by line from your story, in five themes or your own colours
MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 from one story, every frame rendered on its own
The film as an editable HTML page you can preview, scrub and render again
goodFit: Explaining an app or a feature in under 30 seconds
Launch posts, landing-page videos and vertical reels without footage
notFor: Videos with footage, a presenter or voice-over
Long tutorials or step-by-step screen recordings
youBring: What the product does, its name and URL, and a few short facts
Optional: real numbers and screenshots, your brand colours
needs: Google Chrome or Edge (or Playwright's Chromium)

network.purpose: playwright-core for the renderer, installed once
